# [Build a Microsoft Fabric Data Agent (Step by Step)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mFoSVcj6tLw)

**Visibility**: Public
**Uploaded by**: [Guy in a Cube](https://www.youtube.com/@GuyInACube)
**Uploaded at**: 2025-05-15
**Published at**: 
**Length**: 08:52
**Views**: 50813
**Likes**: 863
**Category**: Science & Technology

## Description

```
Yooo! 🙌 take your data skills to the next level and join fellow data professionals in our community THE CUBE: https://guyinacube.com

What if your report consumers could do more than browse reports? In this walkthrough, Marthe demonstrates how to build a Microsoft Fabric Data Agent that combines data from semantic models and lakehouses, adds business context through instructions, improves responses with example queries, validates results against Power BI, and securely shares the experience with users. You'll also see how Data Agents use DAX for semantic models, SQL for lakehouse queries, and how to access the agent with the Fabric Data Agent SDK and Azure AI solutions for enterprise-scale scenarios.

🔗 LINKS
Fabric data agent concepts (preview): https://learn.microsoft.com/fabric/data-science/concept-data-agent

✅ KEY TAKEAWAYS
- Create a Microsoft Fabric Data Agent from scratch.
- Connect semantic models and lakehouse tables as data sources.
- Improve agent accuracy with instructions, metadata, and example queries.
- Validate Data Agent responses by reviewing generated DAX and SQL queries.
- Share agents securely while respecting underlying data permissions.
- Use the Fabric Data Agent SDK and Azure AI integrations for custom applications.

🎥 RELATED VIDEOS
Microsoft Fabric Explained in less than 10 Minutes (Start Here): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NA9pQdRN3F4&list=PLv2BtOtLblH1RhbtfTpp9ovi3Y-3HiRO2&index=1
What is Microsoft Purview? Get the Overview and Unleash Data Governance with Purview & Fabric!: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cwl5gzFeOXA&list=PLv2BtOtLblH3l80JW-YyVgvXeyhnH87Rb&index=8

⏱️ CHAPTERS
00:00 Introduction to Microsoft Fabric Data Agents
00:17 Why Data Agents Matter for Power BI Consumers
01:00 Creating a New Data Agent
01:25 Connecting Semantic Models and Lakehouse Data
02:50 Teaching the Agent with Instructions
04:06 Improving Results with Example Queries
04:48 Testing Questions and Reviewing DAX Queries
05:37 Advanced Analytics and Validation
06:12 Publishing and Sharing the Agent
07:00 Security and Data Permissions
07:38 Using the Fabric Data Agent SDK with Python
08:20 Azure AI and Enterprise Integration
08:34 Final Thoughts and Use Cases

🌐 LET'S CONNECT!
Official website: https://guyinacube.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/guyinacube
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/guyinacube
Instagram: https://instagram.com/guyinacube
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/guyinacube.com
X: https://x.com/guyinacube

🎤 HOST
Marthe Moengen

#microsoftfabric #powerbi #ai #guyinacube
```
